rows: Define the problem in one sentence

rows: You may fix the wrong thing.

blocks.heading: Worked Case You Can Copy
rows: A nearby road was dug up
Ask five regular customers how they reach the shop
If most say yes, add a delivery option
Count walk-ins at the same hour for a week and compare
If footfall splits, sharpen the offer
Check the sales sheet for out-of-stock days
If gaps match low days, fix reordering
